contexts.text: Hence the sons-in-law, and sons (of Lot), by whom were signified such truths (without good), were not saved.

That sons-in-law = truths associated with affections of good and truth; here, which were to be associated, is (because) sons-in-law = Knowledges of truth with which are associated affections of good, which are the daughters, (and) Lot's sons-in-law had not yet married his daughters.

Lot spake to his sons-in-law, that were to marry his daughters () = with those who were in truths to which affections of good could be conjoined. Sons-in-law = Knowledges of truth, consequently, truths... It here treats of the third kind of men within the Church, namely, those who know truths, yet live in evil... These are signified by the sons-in-law. They are especially those who teach... Such have no belief in the truth, except a kind of persuasive one... and are here described by the sons-in-law, in that they believed nothing of the overthrow of Sodom, but laughed at it. AC 2403.
b. A son-in-law = truth associated with the affection of good.
